richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the engine piston crown may develop a crack and create elevated crankcase pressure which may cause the rocker cover to fracture.  A fractured rocker cover may allow oil to escape increasing the risk of a fire.
richiami.modello: ISB4.5E6C210H Diesel Engine , ISB4.5E6C210H Diesel Engine
richiami.rimedio: Fit a crankcase pressure sensor which will trigger an associated fault code and provide visible warning that crankcase pressures are above normal levels.
richiami.titolo: B4.5 Euro VI Valve Cover Cracking Safety Campaign

richiami.difetto: On affected engines the Engine Control Module (ECM) may develop an internal electrical short circuit that could possibly blow a fuse in the ECM’s electrical supply resulting in an engine stall without warning.
richiami.modello: ISB6.7E6A250B Diesel Engine , ISB6.7E6A250B Diesel Engine
richiami.rimedio: Replace the existing ECM with a new (remedy) ECM.
